@import "tailwindcss";
@source "../../../../../../node_modules/streamdown/dist/*.js";
@source "../../../../../../node_modules/@streamdown/code/dist/*.js";
@source "../../../../../../node_modules/@streamdown/cjk/dist/*.js";
@source "../../../../../../node_modules/@streamdown/math/dist/*.js";
@source "../../../../../../node_modules/@streamdown/mermaid/dist/*.js";

/*
 * Modus 设计系统 v4 —— 像素级对标 Cursor 3.0 桌面端：
 *   - 字号一档 11–15px，字距归零，禁止字号忽大忽小
 *   - hairline 极淡（≤ 6% 白），靠明度承载层级
 *   - composer 背景接近 canvas，只浮起一丝（不再像旧版 surface 那么深）
 *   - 强调色仅用于 send 等极少处，平时全灰阶
 */
@theme {
  /* 纯深黑分层：主区/Chat/Inspector 纯深黑，侧栏/菜单栏仅一丝提亮，composer 在主区上轻微浮起 */
  --color-canvas: #131314; /* 主区 / Chat（纯深黑） */
  --color-panel: #161617; /* 侧栏 / 菜单栏（一丝提亮） */
  --color-surface: #1c1c1d; /* 输入框（在主区上轻浮起，对比克制） */
  --color-elevated: #232325; /* 下拉 / 弹层 */
  /* Chat 记录卡片从当前主题的画布与前景色相对派生，三套主题共享同一层级关系。 */
  --color-card: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-canvas) 97%, var(--color-fg) 3%);
  --color-composer-tray: var(--color-panel);

  /* Code surfaces: editor-specific tokens stay out of app UI semantic colours. */
  --color-code-bg: #131314;
  --color-code-fg: #d4d4d4;
  --color-code-line-number: #858585;
  --color-code-line-number-active: #b8b8b8;
  --color-code-active-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
  --color-code-indent-guide: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --color-code-comment: #8b949e;
  --color-code-keyword: #b794f4;
  --color-code-string: #c9a882;
  --color-code-number: #a3b89a;
  --color-code-type: #7db7d4;

  /* hairline 三级 —— 用途分层（明度对齐 Cursor 实测）：
     - soft (0.03)     内部 list 分隔、超细分割
     - hairline (0.05) 面板/composer 等常驻描边
     - strong (0.065)  区域级分隔（menubar 底、sidebar 右、inspector 左）
       —— 6.5% 白：在 #131314 上目测刚好"可见但不抢戏"，0.10 会过亮显脏
     浮层（menu/popover/tooltip）用 --color-popup-border，比 hairline 更淡，
     靠多层 shadow-popup 抬升，避免"线框贴纸"感。 */
  --color-hairline: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  --color-hairline-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  --color-hairline-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.065);
  --color-popup-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

  /* Composer 专属描边：静息态保持克制（只比 hairline 略亮），靠 shadow-composer-edge
     的顶部内高光把输入框"浮起"，而不是用一圈深描边压住主区（图5 的轻盈观感）。 */
  --color-composer-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --color-composer-border-strong: var(--color-composer-border);
  --color-composer-shine: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);

  /* 悬停 / 选中 半透明白叠层 */
  --color-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  --color-active: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);

  /* 文本灰阶 —— 用颜色做层级，不靠字号。主色略软于纯近白，输入/正文更护眼。 */
  --color-fg: #d8d8d7;
  --color-fg-muted: #b4b4b1;
  --color-fg-subtle: #8a8a87;
  --color-fg-faint: #5a5a5d;
  /* Hint / empty-state copy — one step quieter than faint chrome labels. */
  --color-fg-placeholder: #454548;
  --color-icon: #d8d8d6;
  --color-icon-muted: #a6a6a3;

  /* 单一品牌电压：Cursor Orange，仅用于主操作（发送）等极少处 */
  --color-accent: #f54e00;
  --color-accent-hover: #ff5e12;
  --color-accent-active: #d04200;

  /* 主操作卡片强调色（蓝色）：Plan 的 Build 按钮、ask_user 卡片的选中/提交共用。
     与品牌橙(send)区分：这是"确认/提交"的沉稳蓝，配白色文字。单值即可适配明暗。 */
  --color-build: #3b82f6;
  --color-build-hover: #5a96f8;
  --color-build-fg: #ffffff;
  --color-on-accent: #ffffff;

  /* 品牌紫：仅用于输入框聚焦态描边（focus-within），与灰阶基调形成克制的高亮 */
  --color-focus-ring: #853ff4;
  /* 浅一档品牌紫：状态点 / 次级强调 */
  --color-focus-ring-soft: #b388ff;

  /* 文本选区：半透明品牌紫。文字色保留（含代码高亮），暗底上读作柔和紫高亮 */
  --color-selection: rgba(133, 63, 244, 0.42);

  /* Markdown / git graph 链接色（全主题统一 #6299c3；亮色见 light 覆盖 hover） */
  --color-link: #6299c3;
  --color-link-hover: #7eb0d2;

  /* 语义填充叠层：暗色为白色 alpha，亮色覆盖为黑色 alpha —— 用于 chip/pill/tile/ghost 按钮底 */
  --color-chip-faint: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  --color-chip: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  --color-chip-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

  /* 语义色：仅真正的成功/错误状态，平时不出现 */
  --color-success: #3fae87;
  --color-danger: #ef4444;

  /* Diff 行底纹：Git 面板、agent diff、整文件预览共用同一套语义层。 */
  --color-diff-add-bg: #23352b;
  --color-diff-add-gutter: #2d4637;
  --color-diff-del-bg: #3a2824;
  --color-diff-del-gutter: #4b302a;

  /* 字体：Latin=Inter Variable（自托管 opsz+wght）；CJK=Noto Sans SC Variable（自托管）。
   * 系统 Noto/PingFang/YaHei 仅作未覆盖字形兜底——正文光学不再赌机器装了什么。 */
  --font-sans:
    "Inter Variable", "Inter", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Noto Sans SC", "Source Han Sans SC",
    "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC",
    "Microsoft JhengHei", "Noto Sans JP", "Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Sans", "Noto Sans KR",
    "Malgun Gothic", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  /* 深墨实骨：Regular 400 保墨量（375 会被 AA 冲成发灰）；层级仍靠颜色而非堆肉。 */
  --font-weight-normal: 400;
  --font-weight-medium: 520;
  --font-weight-semibold: 600;
  --font-weight-bold: 650;
  --font-mono:
    ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, "Cascadia Mono", monospace;
  --font-terminal:
    "Cascadia Mono", "Cascadia Code", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono",
    monospace;

  --color-terminal-bg: #0c0c0c;
  --color-terminal-fg: #cccccc;
  --color-terminal-selection: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  --color-terminal-ansi-black: #0c0c0c;
  --color-terminal-ansi-red: #c50f1f;
  --color-terminal-ansi-green: #13a10e;
  --color-terminal-ansi-yellow: #c19c00;
  --color-terminal-ansi-blue: #0037da;
  --color-terminal-ansi-magenta: #881798;
  --color-terminal-ansi-cyan: #3a96dd;
  --color-terminal-ansi-white: #cccccc;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-black: #767676;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-red: #e74856;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-green: #16c60c;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-yellow: #f9f1a5;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-blue: #3b78ff;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-magenta: #b4009e;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-cyan: #61d6d6;
  --color-terminal-ansi-bright-white: #f2f2f2;

  /* Global UI scale. Text tokens multiply by --ui-scale. */
  --ui-scale: 1.1;

  /* Type ramp — single ladder for the whole app (chrome + chat + composer).
     Hierarchy is color/weight, not one-off px. Never stack extra 0.9/0.95
     surface shrinks on top of this.
     2xs 11 → timestamps, kbd, uppercase labels
     xs  12 → meta, captions, session titles
     sm  13 → nav, menus, chips, UI body (dominant)
     md  14 → markdown body, composer input
     lg  15 → rare emphasis */
  --text-2xs: calc(11px * var(--ui-scale));
  --text-xs: calc(12px * var(--ui-scale));
  --text-sm: calc(13px * var(--ui-scale));
  --text-md: calc(14px * var(--ui-scale));
  --text-lg: calc(15px * var(--ui-scale));

  /* Icon ladder (px) — mirror lib/uiDensity.ts ICON.* */
  --icon-xs: 12px;
  --icon-sm: 14px;
  --icon-md: 16px;
  --icon-lg: 18px;

  /* 圆角阶梯（DESIGN.md：xs4 / sm6 / md8 / lg12 / xl16 / pill） */
  --radius-xs: 4px;
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 12px;
  --radius-xl: 16px;

  /* hairline-only 纵深：仅给浮层一抹极淡阴影（静息态收得更轻，描边不再压主区） */
  --shadow-composer: 0 1px 8px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
  /* Composer 静息态：在 shadow-composer 基础上叠一道顶部内高光，让上边缘"接住光"
     呈现精致浮起感（Cursor 风）。仅用于输入框/消息编辑框，不污染按钮/药丸。 */
  --shadow-composer-edge:
    inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04), 0 1px 8px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
  /* composer 聚焦态：保留原纵深 + 1px 品牌紫描边环 + 极淡紫色外发光 */
  --shadow-composer-focus:
    0 1px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 0 1px var(--color-focus-ring),
    0 0 16px -3px rgba(133, 63, 244, 0.4);
  /* 浮层纵深：接触影 + 环境影。边界主要由光影暗示，描边只作极淡轮廓。 */
  --shadow-popup: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 8px 24px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);

  --ease-out-quint: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

  /* Scrollbar — edge-flush floating pill; light theme overrides below. */
  --scrollbar-size: 10px;
  --scrollbar-thumb: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --scrollbar-thumb-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}

:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  background: var(--color-canvas);
  letter-spacing: 0;
  font-feature-settings: "cv11", "ss01", "ss03";
  /* Text optical at 13–14px UI — display-leaning opsz thinned strokes into “washed” ink. */
  font-variation-settings: "opsz" 14;
  font-synthesis-weight: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  /* Prefer platform AA (ClearType on Windows). Forced grayscale softens thick CJK into "cheap blur". */
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  font-size: calc(13px * var(--ui-scale));
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/*
 * ── Light theme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * A deliberate second theme (not a naive invert), derived from the dark tokens
 * per modern light-mode rules:
 *   - editor/chat canvas is clean white (#fff);
 *   - chrome panels use neutral #f8f8f8 and lean on hairlines for depth;
 *   - hairlines / hover / active become black-alpha so they read on white;
 *   - text tiers are WCAG-checked dark-on-light (fg≈12:1, muted≈9:1, subtle≈5:1);
 *   - brand accent (orange) and focus purple are preserved across both themes.
 * Only the semantic CSS variables change; every component keeps its classes.
 */
:root[data-theme="light"] {
  color-scheme: light;

  /* Surfaces — clean editor white + neutral panel chrome */
  --color-canvas: #ffffff; /* app base (chat / main / inspector) */
  --color-panel: #f8f8f8; /* sidebar / menubar */
  --color-surface: #ffffff; /* composer / cards / input */
  --color-elevated: #ffffff; /* dropdowns / popovers — white + shadow-popup */
  --color-code-bg: #ffffff; /* code blocks/editors — pure white, matching the clean editor canvas */
  --color-code-fg: #1f2328;
  --color-code-line-number: #6e7781;
  --color-code-line-number-active: #24292f;
  --color-code-active-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  --color-code-indent-guide: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --color-code-comment: #8c959f;
  --color-code-keyword: #c41d7f;
  --color-code-string: #6e7781;
  --color-code-number: #cf222e;
  --color-code-type: #24292f;

  /* Hairlines — Cursor-grade wireframe: faint ink on white, not chalk seams.
   * strong ≈ #e8e8e8 on white (was 0.18 → #d1, too heavy). All border-hairline*
   * consumers inherit this — one place, every seam. */
  --color-hairline: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
  --color-hairline-soft: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.045);
  --color-hairline-strong: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);
  /* 浮层描边比常驻 hairline 更淡 —— 避免白底上画出硬线框 */
  --color-popup-border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);

  /* Composer border on white: a soft resting edge (图5) — the input is carried
     mainly by its shadow + white fill above the white canvas, not a heavy
     outline. Hover/focus is what supplies a readable darker edge. */
  --color-composer-border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.11);
  --color-composer-border-strong: var(--color-composer-border);
  --color-composer-shine: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

  /* Hover / active overlays — black-alpha */
  --color-hover: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  --color-active: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);

  /* Text — soft near-black (Cursor-like): deep enough with weight 400, not chalk #111. */
  --color-fg: #222222;
  --color-fg-muted: #3f3f3f;
  --color-fg-subtle: #666666;
  --color-fg-faint: #8f8f8f;
  --color-fg-placeholder: #b5b5b5;
  --color-icon: #222222;
  /* Toolbar chrome — one step quieter than body icons (Cursor-like). */
  --color-icon-muted: #8a8a87;

  /* Brand accent (send): orange fill works on both themes */
  --color-accent: #f54e00;
  --color-accent-hover: #ff5e12;
  --color-accent-active: #d04200;
  --color-on-accent: #ffffff;

  /* Focus purple — keep brand; soften variant darkened so it reads on white */
  --color-focus-ring: #853ff4;
  --color-focus-ring-soft: #8b5cf6;

  /* Text selection — lighter brand-purple tint so dark text stays readable on white */
  --color-selection: rgba(133, 63, 244, 0.2);

  /* Markdown / git graph link — brand blue #6299c3 */
  --color-link: #6299c3;
  --color-link-hover: #4e84ad;

  /* Semantic fills become black-alpha so chips/tiles read on white */
  --color-chip-faint: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.035);
  --color-chip: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.055);
  --color-chip-strong: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);

  --color-terminal-bg: #ffffff;
  --color-terminal-fg: #111111;
  --color-terminal-selection: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
  --color-terminal-ansi-black: #000000;
